title: Robert Johansson dies
description: Robert "Bob" Johansson signs up with CryoEterna, attends The Vortex SF convention, and dies the next day after being hit by a car.

title: Andrew Handle elected US president
description: The United States elects an ultra-conservative fundamentalist Christian president, Andrew Handle, who brings the USA to the worst economic collapse in its history.
notes: Backstory from book 1, not tied to a chapter in the timeline.

title: Desmond Ahern elected
description: As typical of the political system the United States next elects an atheist president, Desmond Ahern.
notes: Backstory from book 1, not tied to a chapter in the timeline.

title: Fundamentalist coup creates FAITH
description: Fundamentalists stage a successful coup creating the new governing body and the governments of the world are thrown into upheaval with this new world order.
notes: Backstory from book 1, not tied to a chapter in the timeline.

title: Bob reawakens as a replicant
description: Bob is reanimated as a replicant and property of the Free American Independent Theocratic Hegemony (FAITH) government by Doctor Landers, given some history of what's changed in the last century and is told he is in competition with four other replicants for a mission.

title: Bob begins learning how to use his new systems
description: Bob begins learning how to use his new systems.

title: A rival candidate goes insane
description: Bob continues to learn how to use his new systems and is told that one of the other candidates has gone psychotic and been removed from the program.

title: FAITH inspection
description: Bob undergoes an inspection from a Minister of FAITH and continues to be tested on his systems.

title: Two more candidates rejected
description: Bob is told that two more of the candidates have been rejected from the program and that the mission he is training for is to be a Von Neumann Probe and sent out to find new planets for colonization.

title: Bob learns Earth's new politics
description: Bob learns much more about the new political structures and governments of Earth.

title: Attack on the HEAVEN facility
description: Bob helps defend the facility during an attack from an enemy faction.

title: Bob watches as another Minister of FAITH berates Dr
description: Bob watches as another Minister of FAITH berates Dr. Landers about the project.

title: Bob restored from backup; last candidate left
description: Bob is restored from a backup after another attack and told that he is the last replicant remaining in the program.

title: Bob learns of FAITH's safeguards
description: Bob is eventually told that there are safeguards in place to make sure that he follows instructions and does what FAITH tells him to.

title: HEAVEN-1 launches as war breaks out
description: Bob is transferred to his ship and launches while all-out war breaks between the governments of Earth. An enemy probe also launches after Bob and starts following him to Epsilon Eridani.

title: Bob builds his VR and removes FAITH's safeguards
description: Bob begins building his own personal VR world to save his sanity, starts planning to battle the tailing enemy probe, removes the safeguards FAITH set in him, and watches the governments of Earth nuke each other.

title: Arrival at Epsilon Eridani
description: Bob arrives in Epsilon Eridani and begins preparing for the enemy probe.

title: Battle of Epsilon Eridani: Bob defeats Medeiros
description: Bob fights the enemy Brazilian Empire probe, Major Ernesto Medeiros, and wins.

title: First auto-factory
description: Bob begins exploring Epsilon Eridani, finds several planets, and sets up an auto factory station.

title: First clones: Riker, Bill, Milo and Mario
description: Bob clones himself and creates Riker, Bill, Milo, and Mario. Bill stays put at Epsilon Eridani to setup a Skunk Works and names Epsilon Eridani 2 Ragnarök, while Riker begins preparing to return to Earth, and Bob heads for Delta Eridani, Milo heads for Omicron² Eridani, and Mario heads for Beta Hydri.

title: Bill and Riker begin working on new ships and cloning themselves
description: Bill and Riker begin working on new ships and cloning themselves.

title: Garfield and Homer created; Riker leaves for Sol
description: Bill and his clone Garfield continue setting up the Skunk Works and begin working on terraforming Ragnarök, while Riker and his clone Homer leave heading back to Earth.

title: Calvin, Goku and Linus created
description: Bill clones himself three more times creating Calvin, Goku, and Linus; Calvin and Goku together head to Alpha Centauri while Linus heads to Epsilon Indi.

title: SCUT first test
description: Bill and Garfield test out their newly created FTL comms, the Subspace Communications Universal Transceiver (SCUT).

title: Milo discovers Vulcan and Romulus
description: Milo arrives at Omicron² Eridani A and finds two habitable planets and names them Vulcan and Romulus. He sets up an auto station and begins surveying the two habitable worlds.

title: Milo leaves for 82 Eridani
description: Milo finishes surveying Vulcan and Romulus and sets up an auto factory with a high-level AMI per the request of Bill (to remotely connect the system via SCUT in the future), then heads out to 82 Eridani.

title: Riker and Homer reach Sol
description: Riker and Homer return to Sol and begin their fight with the Brazilian probes in the system and find out that the Brazilian probes are dropping asteroids on Earth.

title: Brazilian probes beaten; asteroids diverted
description: Riker and Homer finish the fight with the Brazilian probes and win then divert the remaining asteroids from hitting Earth and begin searching for survivors.

title: Contact with Col. Butterworth
description: Riker and Homer receive a transmission from Colonel George Butterworth of the United States of Eurasia, learn the history of the war, and begin working on colony ships.

title: Riker negotiates with Earth's survivors
description: Riker negotiates with the remaining humans while working with Homer on surveying the system for resources and to get ready for more Bob clones.

title: Charles and Arthur created
description: Riker clones himself twice creating Charles and Arthur and continues searching for survivors, with the remaining human population estimated at 15 million.

title: First post-war UN sessions
description: Riker hosts the first UN sessions.

title: Homer's plan for the UN delegates
description: Homer begins coming up with a plan to appease the UN delegates and contacts Colonel Butterworth.

title: Cranston tries to pressure Riker
description: Minister Cranston from the FAITH enclave attempts and fails to threaten Riker into moving them up the list, while Homer's plan to appease the UN seems to be working.

title: Milo's report reaches Epsilon Eridani
description: Bill and Garfield receive Milo's report about twin habitable planets from Omicron² Eridani and continue working on terraforming Ragnarök.

title: VEHEMENT and Julia Hendricks
description: Riker learns of a terrorist group called VEHEMENT and is introduced to Julia Hendricks, one of the descendants from Bob’s sister, living inside the FAITH enclave.

title: Terraforming Ragnarök; VR physics
description: Bill and Garfield continue working on terraforming Ragnarök and fine-tuning the VR physics.
notes: Timeline note: continuity for these chapters are inconsistent, months should be swapped or combined

title: Sol joins BobNet
description: Riker and Homer connect to BobNet, learn of the twin habitable planets at Omicron² Eridani, and bring the news to the UN.
notes: Timeline note: continuity for these chapters are inconsistent, months should be swapped or combined

title: Battle of Alpha Centauri
description: Calvin arrives at Alpha Centauri B and finds the remains of a USE vessel, while Goku arrives at Alpha Centauri A and finds a Medeiros auto factory. They both meet up and fight with several Medeiros probes and win but one probe escapes. They then start setting up an auto factory station.

title: First colony ships under construction
description: Riker inspects the construction of the first two colony ships while Homer, Charles, and Arthur discuss how to feed the remaining humans for long enough to get them off planet.

title: Bart contacts Bill
description: Bill connects with Bart (a clone of Calvin) at Alpha Centauri through BobNet.

title: Bob discovers the Deltans
description: Bob arrives in Delta Eridani and finds intelligent life on Delta Eridani 4 (later named Eden) and names them Deltans.

title: Archimedes; Marvin, Luke and Bender created
description: Bob continues observing the Deltans, sees one smarter than the rest and names him Archimedes, meanwhile he creates three new clones Marvin, Luke, and Bender.

title: Linus finds Henry Roberts
description: Linus arrives at Epsilon Indi and finds an Australian probe that made it off Earth before the war and stays to help the replicant, Henry Roberts, who is suffering from a mental breakdown from being in isolation for so many decades.

title: Gorilloid attacks; flint for Archimedes
description: Bob watches as the Deltans are attacked by gorilloids and begins leaving flint for Archimedes to find.

title: Bob's drone stops an attack
description: Bob uses a drone to stop another attack against the Deltans and Luke and Bender decide they are heading out while Marvin chooses to stick around for now to help Bob.

title: Milo killed at 82 Eridani
description: Milo makes it to 82 Eridani only to find a Medeiros probe already there and is killed but not before sending word back to Bill at Epsilon Eridani.

title: Luke and Bender depart
description: Bob and Marvin stay to continue monitoring the Deltans while Luke heads out to Kappa Ceti and Bender heads to Gamma Leporis A.

title: First contact with Archimedes
description: Bob uses a drone to make first contact with Archimedes and the rest of the Deltans and convinces them to move back to the previous flint site for their own safety.

title: Arthur killed near Saturn
description: Riker and Homer continue trying to deal with VEHEMENT and the remaining humans though Arthur is killed by a booby trap out by Saturn.

title: The Deltan trek begins
description: Bob begins leading the Deltans back to one of their old settlements in hopes of more food and better shelter and protection from gorilloids.

title: New Zealand hack; donut farms proposed
description: Riker intercepts an attempted hack from New Zealand, discovers the HEAVEN plans were stolen from Australia, and Homer make a breakthrough with plans for donut shaped space stations to use as farmland; FAITH agrees to give up some reserve food for space on 3rd ship.

title: Why the Deltans left Camelot
description: Bob intervenes in another gorilloid attack and learns that the Deltans left their old settlement due to the increased gorilloid population in the area but decides that with his help the Deltans will be able to survive there.

title: Diana introduced
description: Bob watches as a new predator attacks the Deltans and is introduced to a potential mate for Archimedes, Diana.

title: Deltans reach Camelot
description: Bob and Marvin supervise as the Deltans finally reach their old/new settlement, Camelot.

title: Marvin traces Deltan origins
description: Bob continues to observe the Deltans and teach them more advancing skills while Marvin determines the origin area of the Deltans.

title: Android bodies in development
description: Bill and Garfield continue working on terraforming Ragnarök as well as creating physical android bodies.

title: Archimedes learns how Bob replicates
description: Bob and Archimedes continue to talk and learn more about each other, including how Bob replicates.

title: Donut farms inspected
description: Riker and Homer inspect the donut space station farms.

title: Beta Hydri stripped: first sign of the Others
description: Mario arrives at Beta Hydri and finds the system has been cleaned out of all metal as well as the remnants of the alien race that did it (first evidence of The Others), but without any resources he can't create a station to relay word back to Bill so moves on to Zeta Tucanae.

title: Marvin reports an even larger predator
description: Bob gets word from Marvin about an even larger predator that originally hunted the Deltans to almost extinction and they begin looking for it.

title: Archimedes' mating season
description: Bob teaches Archimedes how to defend himself as mating season begins so that he can partner with Diana, and Marvin finds fresh Deltan remains while Bob informs the Deltans of the new threat.

title: Exodus-1 and -2 assembled
description: Riker, Homer, Charles, and Ralph (Arthur's replacement) supervise the final assembly of the first two colony ships Exodus-1 and Exodus-2.

title: Mulder discovers Poseidon
description: Mulder (a clone of Bill) arrives at Eta Cassiopeiae and discovers a planet covered in water which he names Poseidon. He sets up an auto factory and creates two clones Skinner and Jonny.

title: VEHEMENT attack in the Maldives
description: Riker receives word of another VEHEMENT attack in the Maldives, while Homer admits he has been under reporting the production of the farms to establish a surplus.

title: Bert, Ernie and Howard created
description: Riker supervises as the colony ships are loaded and creates Bert and Ernie to fly them, while Charles creates Howard as an escort to Omicron² Eridani.

title: Mulder joins BobNet
description: Mulder receives the SCUT plans and gets connected to BobNet.

title: Bob joins BobNet
description: Bill and Garfield receive word that Bob has joined BobNet, and they all update each other on what's going on.

title: A flying predator destroys a drone
description: Bob and Marvin lose a drone to a flying predator and learn that there is a more dangerous creature to the Deltans than the gorilloids out there.

title: Sam and Exodus-3
description: Riker is missing his extended family who are all heading to Omicron² Eridani with another clone Sam on Exodus-3. Riker speaks with Charles about the recent VEHEMENT attacks and consults with the remaining colonists about the possibility of settling on the newly discovered Poseidon.

title: First Bob-moot
description: Bill holds the first Bob-moot in the Bobiverse.

title: Hippogriff nest destroyed; Bob told to leave
description: Bob and Marvin finally engage with one of the flying predators, calling them hippogriffs, and help to deal with a large-scale attack on the Deltans. Marvin finds their nest, and Bob drops a ship buster on it destroying the colony. The Deltans tell Bob to leave after seeing this show of destruction.

title: Riker deals with another VEHEMENT attack
description: Riker deals with another VEHEMENT attack.

title: Marvin leaves for Pi³ Orionis
description: Bob visits alone with Archimedes. Afterwards Marvin decides to leave and heads out to Pi³ Orionis.

title: Milo's last transmission received
description: Bill receives Milo's last transmission from 82 Eridani.

title: Pete and Victor depart
description: Bob visits Marvin in VR and lets him know that his two new clones, Pete and Victor are preparing to head out. Pete plans to go his own way, while Victor plans to follow Bender to find out what happened to him.
notes: Pete's parent isn't confirmed; the author's genealogy lists Victor only.

title: Another VEHEMENT attack
description: Riker, Charles, and Homer deal with another VEHEMENT attack.

title: VEHEMENT destroys a farm donut
description: Riker and Homer look on at the remains of one of the farming donuts that has been blown up by VEHEMENT.

title: Riker detects an encrypted signal from New Zealand to Homer
description: Riker detects an encrypted signal from New Zealand to Homer.

title: Homer hacked by VEHEMENT
description: Riker and Charles discover that VEHEMENT have infected and taken total control of Homer. They clean out the infection and track back the signal to VEHEMENT headquarters.

title: Homer self-deactivates
description: Riker learns from Charles that Homer has self-deactivated and deleted all his backups.

title: Zeta Tucanae: a murdered civilization
description: Mario arrives at Zeta Tucanae and finds the remnants of an entire industrial civilization that has been wiped out by the Others.

title: Riker finds the VEHEMENT leader
description: Riker finds the VEHEMENT leader.

title: Luke visits from Kappa Ceti
description: Bob continues to monitor the Deltans and gets a surprise visit from Luke at Kappa Ceti.

title: Riker kills Vickers
description: Riker takes out the leader of VEHEMENT, Vickers, and their HQ after learning that Vickers invented replicant systems.

title: Linus returns; Klown Kar Planet
description: Bill connects with Linus who is arriving back at Epsilon Eridani, is introduced to Henry Roberts, and learns of Klown Kar Planet (KKP), a habitable satellite around the Jovian in Epsilon Indi.

title: Buster takes a mate
description: Bob observes as Archimedes' son Buster takes a mate and the Deltan population continues to grow, causing fissures in society and leading to gang activity.

title: Mario at GL 54: four new clones
description: Mario arrives at GL 54 and finds it untouched by the Others. He creates four new clones, Bashful, Dopey, Sleepy, and Hungry and the four new clones decide to head out in different directions to try to find the range of the Others.

title: Mario joins BobNet
description: Mario receives the SCUT plans and gets connected to BobNet.

title: Deltan riots
description: Bob watches as a riot occurs among the Deltans, then he and Archimedes begin planning to repopulate one of the abandoned Deltan villages.

title: Caerleon founded
description: Bobs watches as Archimedes along with the Deltan council convince the gangs to leave and form a second village, Caerleon.

title: Bob watches as Archimedes' family continues to grow
description: Bob watches as Archimedes' family continues to grow.

title: First Battle of 82 Eridani
description: Khan and seven other Bill clones (Hannibal, Tom, Barney, Fred, Kyle/Jackson, Ned/Hector, and Elmer) arrive at 82 Eridani to avenge Milo with several upgrades provided by Bill (plasma spikes). They manage to take out all active Medeiros probes but not the auto factories. Khan is the only Bob to survive and escape.
notes: Kyle and Ned are called 'Jackson' and 'Hector' in this chapter; the author confirmed this was a naming error.

title: Bullwinkle; Loki to lead second strike
description: Bill tests the first android prototype called Bullwinkle, then heads to a VR session with the Bobs that are leading the next charge against Medeiros at 85 Eridani. A backup of Khan, named Loki, is leading. Bill hosts another moot and introduces Henry Roberts to the rest of the Bobs.
notes: The timeline says '85 Eridani', a typo for 82 Eridani.

title: SURGE mover plates
description: Bill demonstrates to Garfield a working asteroid moving system using SURGE pusher plates.

title: Bashful lost at GL 877
description: Bashful arrives at GL 877 and discovers Others activity before being taken offline and self-destructs.

title: Hal finds the Others' homeworld
description: Hal arrives at GL 877 after receiving Bashful's last transmission and finds the Others home system. The Others detect him, and he is taken offline and self-destructs.

title: Moot on the Others threat
description: Bill hosts a moot to discuss the threat from the Others.

title: Colony ships reach Omicron² Eridani
description: Howard, Bert, and Ernie all arrive at Omicron² Eridani and begin helping to colonize Vulcan.

title: Raptors attack Landing
description: Howard works on setting up surveillance and fencing due to local fauna (called raptors) attacking the colony site.

title: Landing colony established
description: Howard continues supervising the setup of the first colony site, called Landing. Security fencing is set up to protect against the raptors, while Bert and Ernie, now with permission to begin offloading, are eager to return to Earth for more colonists.

title: Rocky, the flying android
description: Bill hosts a scrub baseball game with several other Bobs, and after they retire to the VR pub where they talk about the benefits of android bodies and the possible limits of mover plates. Then Bill watches Garfield test his flying android called Rocky.

title: Romulus colonized via Exodus-3
description: Howard supervises the creation of orbital farms, while Sam with Exodus-3 arrives and begins dropping his colonists on Romulus. Howard works at negotiations between all the colonists.

title: Howard meets with Bill and Bob
description: Howard continues supervising the security of Landing, then has a meeting with Bill and Bob, before contacting Col. Butterworth to inform him about the Others.

title: Cupid bugs; Julia revived
description: Howard learns about an egg-laying parasite called a Cupid Bug that has been discovered on Vulcan. Then the colonization of Romulus begins, and Julia and the rest of the extended Bob family are brought out of stasis.

title: Howard meets Bridget
description: Howard meets Dr. Bridget Sheehy.

title: Rudy and Edwin reach KKP
description: Rudy and Edwin (clones of Riker) arrive at KKP with colonists on Exodus-6. Edwin will return to Earth to collect more colonists while Rudy will stay behind to manage the settlement.

title: Howard deals with another raptor attack on Landing
description: Howard deals with another raptor attack on Landing.

title: Whiskey and Stéphane
description: Howard rolls out AMI-controlled surveillance drones to manage the Cupid bug, then has Bridget test his first batch of whiskey and introduces her to Stéphane.

title: Howard and Bridget's whiskey; first 'date'
description: Howard and Bridget produce an acceptable batch of whiskey and then have their first "date."

title: Distillery talk with Bridget and Stéphane
description: Howard chats with Bridget and Stéphane about distillery business and life as a replicant.

title: Howard and Riker begin looking into replicant tech
description: Howard and Riker begin looking into replicant tech.

title: Bridget's tumor surgery
description: Howard stresses as Bridget undergoes surgery to remove a tumor and he sees how close she and Stéphane have become.

title: Archimedes becomes a grandfather
description: Bob watches as Archimedes becomes a grandfather.

title: Marcus and Monty reach Poseidon
description: Mulder greets Marcus and Monty as they arrive at Poseidon with another colony transport. Marcus will stay and eventually take over managing the colony site, while Monty will return to Earth for more colonists.

title: Bridget and Stéphane wed; Howard leaves
description: Howard attends Bridget and Stéphane's wedding then signs over the whiskey business to them as a wedding present and leaves. Dexter agrees to take over management of the system after escorting Exodus-7 to Vulcan.

title: Second Battle of 82 Eridani
description: Loki leads the follow up strike against Medeiros (named replicants include Loki, Elmer, Jeffery, Milton, Zeke, Verne, Surly, and Hank, with four remaining unnamed) at 82 Eridani and wins. They discover three habitable locations: two planets and a moon.

title: Talk of a Bender expedition
description: Bill receives the report back from 82 Eridani, notices the tendency of new Bobs voicing an unwillingness to help humanity, and talk of sending an expedition for Bender begins.

title: Hal scouts GL 877 again
description: Hal returns to GL 877 and scouts the Others in the system then turns around to head back to GL 54.
notes: Hal self-destructed in 2188 (ch. 38). How he survives is uncertain; probably a restored backup.

title: Warning: the Others head for GL 54
description: Hal receives a transmission from Bill that the Others are heading towards GL 54.

title: News from Vulcan; Howie born
description: Howard receives updates from Dexter about how the Vulcan and Romulus colonies are doing. The FAITH colony has removed Cranston from power, Butterworth has retired, and Bridget and Stéphane had a son and named him Howie.

title: Mulder leaves Poseidon
description: Mulder leaves Poseidon, with Marcus staying behind as the Bob-in-residence and Monty returning to Earth for more colonists.

title: First contact attempt with the Others
description: Bill uses a probe left behind by Mario, who is now fleeing to Zeta Tucanae, to make first contact with the Others.

title: Moot: images of the Others
description: Bill holds a moot to discuss the Others and reveal images taken of them from GL 54.

title: Others expedition to NN 4285
description: Bill receives reports from surveillance drones at GL 577 that the Others have launched another expedition, this time to NN 4285. Mario clones Claude and Jacques are heading towards Gamma Pavonis and Delta Pavonis, the next closest systems. Bill tells Claude to start mobilizing for war when he gets there, just in case.
notes: The timeline says 'GL 577', probably a typo for GL 877.

title: Claude at Gamma Pavonis
description: Claude arrives in Gamma Pavonis and finds an excellent planet for colonization.

title: Oliver activated at Alpha Centauri
description: Oliver (a clone of Bill's) is brought online at Alpha Centauri via a SCUT transmitted backup and begins building an armada.

title: Jacques discovers the Pav
description: Jacques discovers intelligent life (Pavs) at Delta Pavonis 4.

title: Bill hosts another moot to discuss the Others
description: Bill hosts another moot to discuss the Others.

title: Others convoy heads for Delta Pavonis
description: Bills received an alert that the Others have launched a convoy towards Delta Pavonis. A moot is held, and reinforcements are launched to Delta Pavonis.

title: Howard at HIP 14101
description: Howard arrives at HIP 14101 and begins exploring a Jovian planet in the system, then receives word from Dexter that Stéphane is dying. Howard contacts Bill about a human android prototype.

title: Stéphane's funeral via Manny
description: Howard uses the human android prototype (Manny) to attend Stéphane's funeral.

title: Butterworth agrees to replication
description: Howard convinces Col. Butterworth to be replicated upon death, but Bridget refuses.

title: Jacques catalogs the Pav's planet and society
description: Jacques catalogs the Pav's planet and society.

title: Bob's Deltan android
description: Bob refines the android prototype and creates a Deltan variant to visit Archimedes on Eden.

title: Howard meets Bridget in an android
description: Howard uses a more refined and realistic android to meet with Bridget.

title: First battle against the Others fails
description: Bill directs the first real attack against the Others and fails at taking them all out. The Others decide to go after Sol and Epsilon Eridani next.

title: Phineas and Ferb rescue 20,000 Pav
description: Phineas and Ferb (clones of Jacques) rescue 20,000 Pav and put them into stasis onboard Refuge-1 and Refuge-2.

title: Delta Pavonis destroyed
description: Bill observes the Others destroy Delta Pavonis, then has an idea on how to deal with the Others permanently.

title: Diana's funeral
description: Bob attends the funeral of Diana, Archimedes' wife, and notes how old Archimedes is now.

title: The Pav choose HIP 84051
description: Bill observes as the Others finish stripping Delta Pavonis and leave. He then wakes Hazjiar and 7 other Pav to ask them if they want to return to their home planet (called Aszjan) or find a new one. They choose to find a new home and start heading for HIP 84051.
notes: The wiki's character pages put Hazjiar's choice in book 3; the timeline says book 2, ch. 77. Marked uncertain.
